skill.name: extension-email-raw
skill.description: Add multi-recipient email delivery to Motoko applications with separate To, Cc, and Bcc lists.
skill.summary: Build Motoko email flows for up to 50 recipients using To, Cc, and Bcc.
skill.author: caffeinelabs

security_audit.summary: All seven static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, and code fences. None execute commands, make requests, or traverse files. A medium privacy concern remains because the sample places attendee arrays in visible To and Cc fields.

remediation.issue: Visible recipient arrays can disclose attendee addresses and attendance categories.
remediation.suggestion: Use Bcc for privacy-separated recipients, or send one message per recipient. Revise the sample to avoid placing user lists in To or Cc.

content.value_statement: Single-recipient email helpers make coordinated messages cumbersome. This skill adds a Motoko sendRawEmail workflow with separate To, Cc, and Bcc recipient lists.
actual_capabilities: Defines a sendRawEmail interface with sender, recipient lists, subject, and HTML body.
Supports separate To, Cc, and Bcc address arrays.
Allows up to 50 combined recipients for one message.
Returns a SendResult with success or error details.
Demonstrates asynchronous Motoko integration for meeting reminders.
limitations: Requires the extension-email skill and the caffeineai-email Motoko package.
Limits each message to 50 total recipients across To, Cc, and Bcc.
Sends identical subject and body content to every recipient.
Visible To and Cc lists can expose addresses, so this skill is unsuitable for bulk service email.

use_cases.title: Build meeting reminders
use_cases.description: Generate a Motoko backend flow that sends one reminder to a trusted group of confirmed and tentative attendees.

use_cases.title: Send internal updates
use_cases.description: Deliver one update with clear To, Cc, and Bcc groups for collaborators who may share contact details.

use_cases.title: Add application notifications
use_cases.description: Integrate multi-recipient transactional messages when every visible recipient belongs to one trusted audience.

prompt_templates.title: Add a basic email
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add a Motoko function that emails {to_addresses}. Use {subject} and {html_body}. Return the SendResult.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first multi-recipient email function.

prompt_templates.title: Separate recipient roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sendRawEmail call with {to_addresses}, {cc_addresses}, and {bcc_addresses}. Keep the total below 50 and handle both result variants.
prompt_templates.scenario: Route recipients through distinct email headers.

prompt_templates.title: Build a meeting reminder
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement a reminder for {meeting_time} and a trusted attendee group. Put private observers in Bcc. Include useful context when delivery fails.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a complete meeting notification flow.

prompt_templates.title: Design privacy-aware delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Motoko delivery function for {recipients}. Use individual messages or Bcc when addresses must remain private. Explain counting and failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a safer advanced delivery workflow.

output_examples.input: Send a reminder to three trusted attendees and one private observer.
output: Delivery plan: place the trusted attendees in To and the private observer in Bcc.
Message plan: use one shared subject and HTML reminder body.
Result plan: acknowledge success or report the returned delivery error.

output_examples.input: Notify 55 recipients with the same update.
output_examples.output: The request exceeds the 50-recipient limit. Split delivery into privacy-safe groups or send individual messages.

best_practices: Count every To, Cc, and Bcc address before sending.
Use Bcc or individual messages when recipients should not see other addresses.
Handle delivery errors without exposing recipient details in user-facing messages.
anti_patterns: Do not place unrelated customers in visible To or Cc lists.
Do not exceed the combined limit of 50 recipients.
Do not ignore the error result after awaiting delivery.

faq.question: What recipient fields does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports separate arrays for To, Cc, and Bcc recipients.

faq.question: How many recipients can one message include?
faq.answer: One message can include up to 50 combined recipients.

faq.question: Is this suitable for bulk service email?
faq.answer: No. Use individual delivery or a bulk email service when recipients must remain private.

faq.question: Can recipients see other addresses?
faq.answer: Recipients can see To and Cc addresses. Bcc addresses are hidden from other recipients.

faq.question: What dependency does the skill require?
faq.answer: It depends on extension-email and the caffeineai-email Motoko package.

faq.question: How are delivery outcomes reported?
faq.answer: SendResult reports success with ok or returns error text with err.
